name: Distribution of Horticulture Kit to Urban and Rural Areas
benefit: 75% subsidy, i.e. distribution of horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 per kit to urban and rural areas (homestead/backyards), through the Additional Director of Agriculture (Horticulture), during Aadipattam/Thaipattam seasonality.
_eligibility_text: All horticulture growers of rural & urban areas are eligible.
